subject: BCP artifacts & recovery timeline evidence request
messages:
From: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@alcedobank.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.com
Cc: security@alcedobank.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: BCP artifacts and recovery timeline evidence

Hi David,

As part of Alcedo Bank's vendor resilience intake for the upcoming SIG review, we need a concise evidence packet that demonstrates Redwood's recovery posture for the inference platform. Specifically we are asking for the following items for our review team:

- A short attestation (1 page) confirming committed RTO/RPO for hosted inference endpoints and dedicated pools; any caveats by region.
- Sample KV-cache warm-start / replay logs covering a two-week window (we're interested in sequences showing cache warm-up and time-to-first-successful-response).
- Redacted runbook snippets for primary restore actions (key-holder procedure, DNS/route rollback, and warm-standby activation steps).
- A calendar availability of a 30-minute live witness session (screenshare + Q&A) during the week of May 31–June 4.

Please note we cannot accept private keys or full raw telemetry; redacted logs and hashed identifiers are fine. Also let us know if you plan to provide a DocuSign attestation.

Target ETA for the packet: Friday, June 3 if possible.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call to scope.

Morgan Lee
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
Alcedo Bank
morgan.lee@alcedobank.com
+1 415-555-0198

[Attachment: SIG-request-template.pdf (pdf)]

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@alcedobank.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: BCP artifacts and recovery timeline evidence

Hi Morgan,

Thanks for the clear list — we can assemble a compact evidence packet that meets your constraints. Quick clarifying Qs to make sure we scope correctly: 

1) Preferred sampling window for the KV-cache logs? You requested a two-week window; we can provide May 10–24 as an example unless you prefer a different period.
2) Level of redaction for runbook snippets: do you want customer-specific hostnames/redacted to tokens or replaced with generic placeholders? We typically deliver "sanitized" snippets with placeholders for hostnames, account IDs, and IPs.
3) Live witness: would you prefer an ops-led walkthrough (we show logs and runbook steps) or an exec attestation call? Ops-led is usually most useful for technical questions.

Ben Carter (included) will coordinate the attestation and delivery timeline; Laura Bennett from Operations will own the runbook and logs. Our initial plan is to produce: one-page attestation PDF, redacted runbook excerpts, a compressed log bundle with a short index, and a proposed witness slot. We will not include private keys or key material.

Can we confirm May 30 as the proposed delivery date? If May 30 works we'll prepare the DocuSign attestation and a Drive folder link.

Best,
David Kim
Head of Customer Resilience
Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0122
